notes.external: Maps are editable JSON. F2 opens the in-game map editor.
notes.tile_types: walls, water, path_cells and object tile coordinates are stored independently.
notes.v3_3: Main objective routes widened; every wall cell has an explicit blocker sprite assignment. Dense wall clusters may use full tree sprites, and those tree cells remain authoritative blockers.
notes.v3_4: Remixed pathways; all walls sprite-backed; large tree roots block while canopy is an overdraw occlusion layer; collectible moth placements and decorative robot placements are external.
notes.v39_floor: Visual floor microtiles are 8px; gameplay/collision cells remain 16px for backwards-compatible external maps.
notes.v39_tin_stream: Tin Stream is a vertical river with a central island and four progressive bridge construction segments.
notes.v39_mini_robots: Mini-robot hint groups are external map content and activate after Pip wakes.
